title: Chair H-O-R-S-E Shooting Game
description: The classic shooting game adapted to the chair: miss a shot your opponent made from the same spot and angle, and earn a letter toward spelling the word.

content.objective: Build creative shot-making under direct, player-to-player competitive pressure.
content.setup: Players take turns attempting any shot of their choosing from anywhere on the court.
instructions: The first player attempts any shot; if it's made, every other player must attempt the exact same shot from the same spot.
Anyone who misses the copied shot earns a letter toward spelling the chosen word.
If the original shot is missed, the next player gets to choose a brand-new shot.
The first player to spell the whole word is eliminated; last player remaining wins.
coachingPoints: Choose shots that are challenging but still realistic, not just silly trick shots.
Stay focused on your own shot even while waiting your turn.
Use this as a chance to practise shots from spots you'd actually use in a game.
commonMistakes: Choosing shots that are impossible for anyone to replicate, which isn't useful practice.
Getting distracted and missing your turn's shot attempt.
Rushing decisions just because the format feels competitive.
content.safety: Keep the shooting area clear of other players' rebounds.
